description: Source code for Ethernet bridge implementation in Zephyr OS, managing network interfaces, packet forwarding, and bridge configuration.

methods.name: lock_bridge
methods.description: Initializes and locks the Ethernet bridge mutex, lazy-initializing if necessary.

methods.name: net_eth_bridge_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all Ethernet bridges, executing a callback for each.

methods.name: eth_bridge_get_index
methods.description: Returns the index of a given Ethernet bridge within the global list.

methods.name: eth_bridge_get_by_index
methods.description: Retrieves an Ethernet bridge by its index.

methods.name: eth_bridge_iface_add
methods.description: Adds a network interface to the Ethernet bridge, enabling promiscuous mode.

methods.name: eth_bridge_iface_remove
methods.description: Removes a network interface from the Ethernet bridge.

methods.name: eth_bridge_iface_allow_tx
methods.description: Sets whether a network interface is allowed to transmit through the bridge.

methods.name: eth_bridge_listener_add
methods.description: Adds a listener to the Ethernet bridge.

methods.name: eth_bridge_listener_remove
methods.description: Removes a listener from the Ethernet bridge.

methods.name: net_eth_bridge_input
methods.description: Handles incoming Ethernet packets, forwarding them to registered interfaces and listeners, with filtering for link-local addresses.
